purpose: Preserve original Code First and its answer, previous learning, three exam questions with answers and visuals, and challenge. Replace only the archived old You Do questions inside the opt-in exam bank preview; other phases and timed practice remain intact.

code_first.q: Trace an adjacent comparison of two file sizes in a bubble-sort pass.
code_first.code:
leftGB = 6
rightGB = 1
if leftGB > rightGB then
    print("Swap")
endif
p: Write the three assignments needed to swap the original sizes safely. Why is sorting different from calculating their combined storage?
code_first.a: 6>1, so Swap prints. With leftGB=0 there is no output. To exchange the original values: temp=leftGB; leftGB=rightGB; rightGB=temp. Sorting reorders file sizes; total storage requires adding them: 6+1=7 GB.

optional_original_challenge.coreHint: Bubble sort compares neighbouring values. Save one in temp before overwriting it.

stretch.task: Write the three assignments to swap leftGB=6 and rightGB=1 using temp.
stretch.hint: Save the original leftGB before overwriting it.
stretch.answer: temp=leftGB; leftGB=rightGB; rightGB=temp gives leftGB=1 and rightGB=6.

mastery.task: Complete one bubble-sort pass on [6,1,4,2] in OCR-style code and explain where the largest item ends up.
mastery.hint: Compare adjacent indexes; swap when first > second.
mastery.answer: After pass: [1,4,2,6]. The largest6 is last. For [1,2,3], zero swaps.
